title: One candidate builder from closed predicates

story.i_want_to: triage's and implement's candidate queries built from one predicate set
story.so_that: a new spec picks its stories by listing predicates, not by writing a query

rationale: TriageDispatcher.candidates (triage_dispatcher.ex:162-246) and DispatchDriver.candidates (dispatch_driver.ex:127-199) share ranking and most filters but are written twice.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.Agents.Candidates.query(spec, opts) builds the query from the spec's predicate list, drawn from a closed set: {:stage, s}, :intake_record_required, :intake_record_optional, :single_active_source, :issue_not_closed, :requires_ticket_if_source_says, :no_live_dispatch_of_self, {:agent_status_in, list}, :dependencies_met; ranking :round_robin_project_tenant is shared.

On one fixture corpus covering every predicate (closed issue, ticket filter on and off, two active sources, a live dispatch, unmet story and epic dependencies, pending vs contracted, an authored story with no intake record), the new query returns the same ordered list as the old candidates/1 for both kinds.
TriageDispatcher.candidates/1 and DispatchDriver.candidates/1 delegate to the builder; their callers are unchanged.
Tenant isolation: tenant A's candidates never include tenant B's stories.

test_cases.name: triage equivalence
steps: run old and new triage queries

test_cases.name: implement equivalence
steps: run old and new implement queries

technical_notes: Keep the per-project ranking from #1019 and the closed-issue filter from #1022 as predicates, with their tests.
